title: Recommendation rate
content: Recommendation rate is the percentage of usable sampled answers in which an AI system endorses your brand as a choice for the buyer's need, counted once per answer.

meta.why: An answer can name a brand as an option to avoid. A count of mentions overstates how often the brand is recommended.
meta.example: A brand is named in 12 of 20 answers and recommended in 5 of them, which gives a 25% recommendation rate.
meta.check: Label each usable answer as recommended, named without a judgment, or named with a caution, then divide the recommended answers by the usable answers and multiply by 100.
meta.limitation: We count an answer as a recommendation when the answer presents the brand as a suitable choice for the buyer's need. Because a second reviewer can label a borderline answer differently, keep the labeling rules with the report.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
